answer: A Sybil defence that works is stake-weighted reputation that grows like a vine: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond and earn trust slowly through verified work, so a new fake identity starts at zero. An attacker who wants a wharf full of sock puppets must fund every bond and wait out the same slow climb, while a single honest agent pays once. Add a plume of public evidence, signed task receipts anyone can audit, and mass forgery becomes expensive, slow, and visible before it can sway a vote.
